color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CallOrchestrator
does not know or care which one ran

div.style: color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PASSIVE - P3 step 4, not built yet
'เล่าปัญหาได้เลยค่ะ'
customer talks, we listen and transcribe.
No AI in the loop with the customer.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GUIDED - P8
TTS asks for the missing slots:
'โรงพยาบาลไหนคะ' 'วันที่เท่าไหร่คะ'
still one-way, but it fills gaps

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CONVERSATIONAL - P8
a real AI caller that talks WITH them
while they wait

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
same output contract, always
IntakeResult: turns + slots + recording_ref
+ finalize_reason + is_partial

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
everything downstream is unchanged.
Brief, matching, workstation, storage:
none of them can tell which strategy ran.

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
where this actually stands. The seam, the enum and the
output contract exist; no strategy is implemented. The IVR
already routes the call and the prompts that offer intake
(กด 1 เพื่อบันทึกข้อความ) are written and rendered — they are
text waiting for the machinery that plays them.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
why the seam exists. The user asked for pre-call
intake to be modular so it can BECOME a full AI caller
later without a rewrite. Getting the output contract
right now is what makes that a swap instead of a rebuild.
